This release redesigns the Hardcover experience with a single reading-status selector, half-star ratings, clearer book matching, and updates queued offline before sending. Syncing from a book now frees the reader's memory before connecting and returns to the book afterward. Hardcover Library adds book details and pagination, while setup and sync results use consistent, clearer screens. LibGen now preserves searches when retrying and shows completed downloads with an Open action, avoiding accidental duplicate downloads. A native Windows simulator and refreshed screenshots make desktop UI testing easier.
